review_text: I have used Gutter Pro for several years. They have been great. I found out they combined with Ned's Home and I decided to use them. Never again. The two guys could not speak or understand english. We used a cell phone to translate our conversations so we could understand one another. They left debris on top of my shrubs. I thought this was my local Gutter Pro. They want you to set up appointments in the future for your guttering cleaning. I told them no but the lady kept trying to get me to set an appointment. I told her no because I was not going to use them anymore. I am not sure she cancelled my appointment in December. I was not happy with them at all.

DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES USE THIS COMPANY. I wish I could give them zero stars. They installed the whole strip of back gutters on my house back in May 2023 when I had my roofing company redo my roof. They were working under the roofing company so I trusted they were vetted/good as I liked the roofing company itself. Since then, over the last year or so the middle section of the gutters they installed has been receding from my house, pretty severely. I tried calling them time and time again and spoke with the owner and he said he'd get back to me to put me on the schedule and then would never call me back. I did this like 5 times which feels fishy to me now. Finally got a more reputable company to come out and diagnose the issue and they said the drip edge was very obviously incorrectly installed, they wedged it between the gutter and the house when it needs to protrude over the gutters to divert the water otherwise the water drips straight down and rots out the support beams which was happening. When the beams rot out the screw that's in them to support the gutters to the house recedes and the gutters essential fall off the house, that's what was happening. I was told they need to take it all off and add a completely new gutter and new support beams for the rotted ones..will likely be $2,000 worth of work for gutters that were supposed to last wayyyyy beyond 1.5 years and did obvious damage to my home.

This local business responded promptly, gave a very reasonable estimate, provided a quick appointment time, arrived as scheduled, notified us prior to arrival, allowed contactless service, did a good job. The men who did our job (Eli, Allen, and Ben) were professional, quick, pleasant, efficient, and they cleaned up the debris. Sadie, the scheduler, is pleasant and efficient and answers all questions. Our gutters were full of leaves, pine needles, branches, and pine cones from a recent storm; they used blowers to clean the gutters and downspouts out quickly. We will use them again. We plan to schedule their services twice a year to maintain the water flow in the gutters.
Very professional and dependable. Shane can easily access our roof when other companies cannot.
These guys have been cleaning my home's gutters for several years and they do a great job! They leave the eaves and gutters clean and blow the debris away. I would highly recommend them.
Quickly got set up, cleaned the gutter and cleaned up the ground and properly disposed of the debris. Highly recommend and will use them again.
Did an excellent job and the team was very professional and courteous. They have always done a thorough job cleaning my gutters and also leave my decks and driveway clean of leaves.
